svg.title: Binit moves nvm's cost from every new shell to the first node command
svg.desc: Binit moves nvm's cost from every new shell to the first node command. nvm v0.41.0 with Node 26 as the default, loaded by each tool's own nvm support. Each loader ran with and without nvm; medians of 15 interleaved launches. Reported, not scored. What nvm adds to a new shell: Binit 2.2 ms, Oh My Bash 25.7 ms, Bash-it 39.7 ms, Plain .bashrc 23.2 ms. First node --version: Binit 28.0 ms, Oh My Bash 2.5 ms, Bash-it 3.4 ms, Plain .bashrc 2.5 ms. Binit 0.1.0 on one Linux machine: Ryzen 7 9800X3D, GNU Bash 5.3.20.
